Increased listing completion rates by 10%.
Users can list items in 50% less time with AI-powered automation.
Serves more than 3 million users on Sweden's largest secondhand marketplace.

運用 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 變革品牌探索與消費者購物旅程。

AI-powered Product Detail Page assistant reads full item specifications to answer customer questions.
Bridges the information gap in online fashion retail through conversational AI.
Enhances customer confidence and reduces purchase uncertainty.

overview.en: Wendy's developed FreshAI in partnership with Google Cloud, using Gemini's generative AI capabilities combined with audio and visual elements to automate drive-thru ordering. Unlike rule-based systems, FreshAI generates contextual responses in real-time. Starting as a Columbus, Ohio pilot in 2023, the system expanded to franchisees in 2024 and is now processing tens of thousands of orders daily.
overview.zh: Wendy's 與 Google Cloud 合作開發了 FreshAI，運用 Gemini 生成式 AI 能力結合音頻和視覺元素，自動化得來速點餐流程。與規則式系統不同，FreshAI 能即時生成情境性回應。從 2023 年俄亥俄州哥倫布市的試點計畫開始，系統於 2024 年擴展至加盟商，目前每日處理數萬筆訂單。

en: FreshAI shaved 22 seconds off service times at the Columbus, Ohio test site.
Achieved 86% accuracy — orders handled without team member intervention — during pilot.
Now processing tens of thousands of orders daily across multiple states.
Generative AI generates contextual responses in real-time rather than following a fixed rule set.
zh: FreshAI 在俄亥俄州哥倫布市試點期間，服務時間縮短 22 秒。
試點期間達到 86% 的準確率，即無需員工介入即可完成訂單的比例。
目前每日在多個州處理數萬筆訂單。
